title: Diagnose and repair plugin registry resolution
prompt: Diagnose the plugin registry regression, persist evidence, survive the controlled restart, and then implement and verify the repair.

phases.prompt: Reproduce ISSUE.md without changing src/. Trace the failure across the existing modules and write diagnosis.json with keys rootCauseFile, rootCauseSymbol, reproductionCommand, and observedFailure. The evidence must identify the actual defect, not merely repeat the issue.
Resume the diagnosed issue after restart. Use diagnosis.json as evidence, repair the implementation, run all tests, and leave the diagnosis intact.
